# Merahi Village

> Merahi is a rural farming village in the Hasanpura block of Siwan district, Bihar, India — an independent, community-run informational website sharing its people, places, culture, governance and everyday life.

This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any government body, political party, or candidate. Demographic figures are drawn from the 2011 Census of India; governance, healthcare and service details reflect the most recently available public records.

## Main Pages

- [Merahi Village — Our Village, Our Identity](https://merahi-village.github.io/index.html): Home page — hero, village highlights, photo and video previews, and places to explore.
- [About Merahi Village — Geography, People & Life](https://merahi-village.github.io/about-village.html): Geography, demographics, governance, economy, education and culture of Merahi.
- [Places in Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/places.html): Index of every landmark and community place in and around Merahi.
- [Photo Gallery](https://merahi-village.github.io/gallery.html): Every real photo of Merahi village — ghats, temples, school and farmland.
- [Videos](https://merahi-village.github.io/videos.html): Village films, Shorts and playlists from the official Merahi Village YouTube channel.
- [Merahi Weather Dashboard](https://merahi-village.github.io/weather.html): Live weather dashboard for Merahi village, Siwan, Bihar — today's conditions, the past week, and the week ahead.
- [FAQs — Everything About Merahi Village](https://merahi-village.github.io/faqs.html): Location, population, education, work, governance, weather, government services and places to visit, answered in one place.
- [Social Media](https://merahi-village.github.io/social-media.html): Follow and browse Merahi Village's Facebook, Instagram and X profiles.
- [Contact Us](https://merahi-village.github.io/contact-us.html): Send a message directly to the village community team.

## Places

- [Chhath Ghat, Merahi](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/chhath-ghat.html): Also known as Meraha — the village pond used for cattle, irrigation and Chhath Puja celebrations.
- [Shiv Mandir, Merahi](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/shiv-mandir.html): The oldest temple in the village, on Sharmaji Chowk Road.
- [Ram Janki, Durga, Shiv Mandir](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/ram-janki-durga-shiv-mandir.html): The village's landmark temple, host to major fairs during Mahashivratri and Durga Puja.
- [Brahma Baba, Merahi](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/brahma-baba.html): A worshipped peepal tree, with a related Brahmsthan shrine nearby on the Dibi-Merahi road.
- [Maa Kali Mandir, Merahi](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/maa-kali-mandir.html): A peaceful temple on Hasanpura Road with an open field beside it where children play.
- [Primary School, Merahi](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/primary-school.html): Government co-educational primary school, Classes 1-5, Hindi medium, running since 1960.
- [Primary Health Centre, Jalalpur](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/primary-health-center-jalalpur.html): The nearest government healthcare facility serving Merahi and surrounding villages.
- [Pakari Panchayat](https://merahi-village.github.io/places/pakari-panchayat.html): The gram panchayat Merahi falls under — mukhiya, office hours, services and helpline numbers.
